# ICSE SEET 2027

The Software Engineering Education and Training (SEET) track of ICSE 2027 is the premier venue bringing together educators from academia and industry worldwide to share cutting-edge results and experiences on shaping software engineers who can deal with real-world challenges.

## Scope

- Contributes to all dimensions of **learning and teaching software engineering topics**, from primary and secondary education to undergraduate/graduate university education, coding clubs, hackathons, bootcamps, industrial training, and informal learning.
- Motivated by the need for balanced **soft and technical skills** and, increasingly, collaboration with AI systems while maintaining human-centered competencies.
- Seeks challenges, innovations, and best practices in software engineering education and training.
